post.summary: Log verified visit and award coins
post.description: Verified hospitals: donation, screening or endorsement. NGOs: attendance only. Server controls facility identity, dates and points. Attendance requires owned camp, registered donor and started camp. One endorsement per hospital/donor. Whole-blood donation adds one inventory unit. Clinical donation requires quantity, hemoglobin and bloodPressure. Same scheduling interval used for all donation types as a lab policy.
